commit.message:
RISC-V: Optimize conditional arithmetic with Zicond

Recognize conditional add, subtract, and, or, and xor CMove patterns
and rewrite them around a zero-result conditional move.

Add RISC-V match rules that use the compared register directly as
the Zicond condition, plus IR coverage for int/long, eq/ne,
mixed-width conditions, reversed forms, sharing, and the
UseZicond gate.

Co-authored-by: Pengcheng Wang <wangpengcheng.pp@bytedance.com>
